content: The information provided about this product is intended to be general and does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. It is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and how it relates to your individual health requirements. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is important to maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication can be harmful if swallowed inappropriately. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less urgent cases, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional for complete and personalized information about this product and your specific health needs. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions to access the offer.
